heading: Assistance to build local capacity in agricultural biosecurity planning, preparedness, and response

children.heading: Grant assistance
children.text: The Secretary shall establish a competitive grant program to support the development and expansion of advanced training programs in agricultural biosecurity planning and response for food science professionals and veterinarians.

children.heading: Authorization of appropriations
children.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this subsection—
such sums as are necessary for each of fiscal years 2008 through 2013; and
$15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2014 through 2023.

children.heading: Grant and loan assistance
children.text: The Secretary shall establish a competitive grant and low-interest loan assistance program to assist States in assessing agricultural disease response capability.

children.heading: Authorization of appropriations
children.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subsection—
$25,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2008 through 2013; and
$15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2014 through 2023.
